sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: MathVision: Qwen3.8-27B is evaluated using the fixed prompt: "Please reason step by step, and put your final answer within \boxed {}." For the remaining models, we report the higher score from two prompt variants—one with and one without the \boxed {} formatting requirement.

sources.title: How to Run Qwen 3.8 27B on Your Own Computer - lu-labs.ai
sources.snippet: The 2.4 trillion parameter giant opened up on 12 August under Alibaba's own qwen3.8-max licence, and it needs a data center either way. Qwen 3.8 27B followed on 13 August under Apache 2.0, and it is a dense model built to fit on a single graphics card or a decent laptop. This post is about the 27B.

sources.title: Qwen3.8 - How to Run Locally | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8 is Qwen's new model family, featuring Qwen3.8- 27B, Qwen3.8- 2.4T-A95B and Qwen3.8- Max. Qwen3.8-27B has vision and reasoning capabilities, a 256K context window, and runs locally on 17GB RAM/VRAM setups. Qwen3.8 excels at agentic coding, vision and chat tasks, and can now run via Unsloth GGUFs, NVFP4 and Unsloth Desktop.
